source: 617 Transaction
target: Transactio 617

source: Flores’s demeanor suddenly shifted, his expression turning icy, and a malevolent smile curling upon his lips.
target: Mores Flores subitāneē commutatus est, vultus eius in gelu versus, atque risus malignus labris incurvans apparuit.

source: His aura underwent a dramatic transformation.
target: Aura eius transformationem egregiam passa est.

source: He raised his gaze, Lumian’s dark hair and green eyes reflecting in his now ominous stare.
target: Oculos attollit, et capilli obscuri atque oculi virides Lumiani in aspectu eius iam ominoso resplendebant.

source: Lumian’s suppressed emotions, desires, and the haze surrounding him erupted like a volcano.
target: Affectūs repressi, desideria, atque nebula eum circumdantes quasi vulcāno erumpebant.

source: This was a force even an Ascetic’s endurance couldn’t withstand.
target: Haec vis erat, quam etiam tolerantia ascētæ superare non potuit.

source: Crack!
target: Crepitus!

source: Lumian’s body cracked, shrinking into a palm‑sized mirror.
target: Corpus Lumiani crepuit, atque in speculum mensura palmae redactum est.

source: The mirror shattered completely, fragments scattering across the ground.
target: Speculum omnino confractum est, fragmenta per terram dispersa erant.

source: In the room diagonally opposite, Lumian materialized beside Franca, wearing a solemn expression.
target: In conclavi diagonaliter opposito, Lumian iuxta Francam apparuit, vultum sollemnem gerens.

source: Had he not prepared Mirror Substitution beforehand, he might have endured a double explosion of emotions and desires.
target: Nisi substitutionem speculi antea praeparavisset, duplicem eruptionem affectuum et desideriorum fortasse toleravisset.

source: It resembled the same outcome when evil god bestowed heard the Symphony of Hatred’s different melodies.
target: Eadem eventus apparuit, sicut cum deus maleficus varias symphonias odii diffudit.

source: Of course, if Franca hadn’t been lurking nearby, if he hadn’t readied Mirror Substitution, he wouldn’t have used himself as bait to “converse” with Flores.
target: Scilicet, nisi Franca prope insidiasset, et nisi substitutionem speculi praeparavisset, se uti esca ad “conloquendum” cum Flores non fecisset.

source: Lumian seized Franca’s shoulder, his voice deep as he uttered, “Let’s leave this place first.”
target: Lumian umerum Francae arripuit, voce profunda, et dixit: “Primum hunc locum relinquamus.”

source: He promptly activated the black mark on his right shoulder, in an attempt to teleport away.
target: Celeriter maculam nigrum in umero dextro excitavit, conatu se translocare.

source: Confronted with an adversary capable of exploiting his weaknesses and latent dangers, Lumian’s initial response was to switch to support, utilizing his corresponding abilities from a distance.
target: Oppositum habens adversarium, qui infirmitates eius et pericula latenta exponere poterat, responsum initium Lumiani fuit ad auxilium transire, facultates pertinentes a longinquo adhibens.

source: Franca would assume the role of the main attacker.
target: Franca munus principali aggressoris suscipere destinata erat.

source: However, considering Franca, a Demoness of Pleasure, hadn’t indulged herself for a long time, he feared she might not resist the explosion of desire.
target: Attamen, dato quod Franca—Demonissa Voluptatis—diu se non indulgebat, timebat ne eruptioni desiderii obsistere non posset.

source: It seemed prudent to retreat, regroup with others, and return later.
target: Consilium videri prudenti: recedere, cum aliis coire, et postea redire.

source: At that moment, a voice alternating between masculinity and femininity echoed in Lumian and Franca’s ears.
target: In eo momento vox, inter virilem et feminam alternans, in auribus Lumiani et Francae resonabat.

source: “There’s no rush to escape. I’ve changed my mind. I want to make a deal with you.”
target: «Non est festinandum effugere. Mentem mutavi. Tecum pactum facere volo.»

source: A deal? Something jolted in Lumian’s and Franca’s minds.
target: Pactum? Aliquid in animis Lumiani et Francae concussit.

source: After some thought, they chose to stay put.
target: Post aliquam meditationem, manere constituerunt.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian sank his consciousness into his right hand, ready to activate the remnant aura of Blood Emperor Alista Tudor.
target: Simul, Lumian conscientiam suam in manu dextro demergit, paratus ad remanentem auram Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor excitandam.

source: This wasn’t meant to intimidate Flores, but if his emotions and desires were triggered again, Lumian could “alert the police” in time!
target: Hoc non ad Flores intimidandum destinatum erat, sed si affectūs et desideria eius iterum excitata essent, Lumian tempestive “vigiles” certiores facere posset!

source: Being one of the Feynapotter Kingdom’s primary ports for trade with the Southern Continent and a key base for the Harvest Fleet, Port Colla undoubtedly housed at least one Grade 1 Sealed Artifact even without a demigod.
target: Quoniam Portus Colla, unus ex principalibus portis regni Feynapotter ad commercium cum continente meridionali et basis praecipua classis Vindemiatorum erat, indubitanter saltem unum Artefactum Sigillatum Gradus I continebat, etiam sine semideo.

source: Franca gazed at the wall and the air in front of her, questioning, “What deal?”
target: Franca parietem et aerem ante se intuens, inquisivit: “Quid pacto?”

source: Flores, dressed in a floral shirt, casually pushed open the unlatched door of the apartment and spoke in a deep, cold, and dignified manner,
target: Flores, camisia florata indutus, casualiter ostium clausum aperuit et voce profunda, frigida ac digna locutus est,

source: “Let me introduce myself. Naboredisley, a Demon.”
target: «Permitte mihi me introducere. Naboredisley, daemon.»

source: A Demon? A genuine Demon… The cost of using the Authority Holder’s Under‑the‑table Transaction actually materialized here–to make a deal with a Demon…
target: Daemon? Vere daemon? Pretium utendi Transactione sub mensa Auctoritatis hic manifeste apparuit—ad pactum cum daemon faciendum…

source: However, Lumian’s acceptance of the captain’s mission and our pursuit of Delilah are distinct matters.
target: Attamen, acceptio missionis capitanei a Lumiano et nostra persecutio ad Delilah res distinctae sunt.

source: If we had opted to patiently wait a month or two before engaging with Delilah instead of utilizing the Authority Holder’s Under‑the‑table Transaction, what would have transpired today?
target: Si constitui essemus ut mensem vel duos patienter exspectaremus antequam cum Delilah ageremus, pro usu Transactionis sub mensa Auctoritatis, quid hodie eveniret?

source: Could there have been a so‑called deal?
target: Numquid pactum, ut fertur, esse potuisset?

source: Franca smiled in surprise, suspicion, and confusion.
target: Franca cum admiratione, suspicione, atque confusione subridet.

source: “How can you reveal yourself as a Demon?
target: “Shouldn’t a true Demon conceal their identity to lower our guard?”

source: The Demon, identifying himself as Naboredisley, clenched his right fist and pressed it against his lips.
target: Daemon, se Naboredisley esse declarans, dextrum pugnum contraxit et illud ad labia apposuit.

source: He smiled and replied, “A true Demon is both Demon in body and mind.
target: Risus efferens respondit: «Verus daemon et corpore et mente daemon est.

source: I’ll inform you that you’re dealing with a Demon, but refusal isn’t an option.
target: Te certiorem faciam te cum daemon agere, sed recusatio non est optio.

source: I won’t obscure my identity to achieve my goals like the foolish ones.
target: Non celabo identitatem meam ad metas meas assequendas, ut stulti id fecerunt.

source: For instance, this man named Flores is well aware of the consequences of repeatedly reciting my true name through the notebook.
target: Exempli gratia, hic vir, Flores nominatus, bene novit consequentias mei veri nominis per libellum iterum recitandi.

source: Heh heh, back then, that foolish Warlock labeled it the Love Incantation, but he still couldn’t resist the temptation and couldn’t control himself.
target: Heh heh, tunc ille stultus magus id Incantationem Amoris appellavit, sed tamen tentationi resistere nec se coercere potuit.

source: Haha, for Demons, this gradually decaying soul that slowly descends into the Abyss is the most delectable feast.
target: Haha, nam daemonibus, haec anima paulatim putrescens et lente in Abyssum descendens, epulum delectabilem maxime constituit.

source: The sensation of resistance and constant decay is as unforgettable as the finest wine.
target: Sensatio resistendi et continuae corruptionis tam inobliterabilis est quam optimus vinum.

source: Lumian and Franca didn’t disdain or ridicule Naboredisley’s unabashed and alluring depravity.
target: Lumian et Franca non contemnoverunt neque irriserunt nequitiam Naboredisley sincerae atque allicientis.

source: Since a Demon had spoken, there had to be a deeper motive!
target: Cum daemon locutus esset, necessaria erat aliquid ulterioris.

source: Moreover, Lumian couldn’t be certain if Naboredisley was a genuine Demon or a self‑proclaimed one.
target: Praeterea, Lumian certus esse non potuit utrum Naboredisley verus daemon esset aut se ipse proclamaverit.

source: He couldn’t verify if Naboredisley was his actual name or if he had a different origin.
target: Non potuit comprobari utrum Naboredisley nomen suum verum haberet aut ex alia origine proveniret.

source: Although the activation of desire aligned with the traits of a Sequence 5 Desire Apostle of the Demon pathway, it wasn’t exclusive to Demons.
target: Quamquam activatio cupiditatis notis Seriei V, Apostoli Desiderii in via daemonica conveniebat, illa tamen daemonibus sola non destinata erat.

source: Lumian’s Symphony of Hatred could achieve a similar effect.
target: Symphonia Odii Lumiani effectum similem efficere poterat.

source: Franca grinned at the Demon’s incessant narrative and remarked, “That foolish Warlock probably assumed your true name as a Love Incantation because of your cues. Is that really your true name?”
target: Franca daemonis ininterrotta narratione subridet et dixit: «Ille stultus magus verisimiliter tuum verum nomen ut Incantationem Amoris ob signa tua accepit. Num vere tuum nomen verum est?»

source: “That’s why he’s foolish,” Naboredisley replied with a faint smile.
target: «Ideo stultus est,» respondit Naboredisley subridente leviter.

source: Lumian wasn’t eager to rush into the transaction.
target: Lumian transactioni festinandi non studebat.

source: Instead, he inquired, “How did you manage to convince Flores that the Love Incantation actually works?”
target: Pro eo, rogavit: «Quomodo Flores persuadisti Incantationem Amoris vere efficacem esse?»

source: Naboredisley casually glanced back at Flores’s rented apartment and assumed a relaxed posture.
target: Naboredisley leviter retrospexit ad locum Flores conductum et habitum relaxatum assumpsit.

source: “He tried some other incantations from the notebook, and some of them worked.”
target: «Alias incantationes ex libello temptavit, et nonnullae operatae sunt.»

source: “He’s just an ordinary person, yet he can cast an incantation like a Warlock?” Franca expressed disbelief.
target: «Homo tantum ordinarius est, sed tamen incantationem sicut magus canere potest?» Franca incredulitate exprimitur.

source: Naboredisley grinned.
target: Naboredisley subridens.

source: “I’ve heard a very reasonable saying: ‘All things possess godhood.’
target: «Audivi proverbium valde rationabile: “Omnia deitate praedita sunt.”

source: “No matter how ordinary a person is, as long as they’re willing to pay the corresponding price, they can create Beyonder effects.”
target: «Quamvis homo simplicissimus sit, dummodo pretium conveniens solvat, effectus transcendentales creare possit.»

source: All things possess godhood… Mr. K often says this when preaching… Lumian observed Naboredisley, the self‑proclaimed Demon.
target: Omnia deitate praedita sunt… Dominus K hoc saepe dicit cum praedicat… Lumian observavit Naboredisley, daemon se ipso proclamatum.

source: Franca seized the opportunity to ask, “What price did Flores pay?”
target: Franca occasionem captavit et interrogavit: «Quod pretium Flores solvit?»

source: Naboredisley smiled meaningfully. “I already told you.”
target: Naboredisley subridens significanter respondit: «Iam tibi dixi.»

source: The part where the soul gradually decays and falls into the Abyss?
target: Pars, in qua anima paulatim corrumpetur et in Abyssum cadit?

source: Franca nodded thoughtfully.
target: Franca cogitabunde annuit.

source: Lumian suddenly grinned.
target: Lumian subito subridens apparuit.

source: “If he hadn’t paid the price, how could you communicate with us so easily using his body?”
target: «Si pretium non solvisset, quomodo per eius corpus tam facile nobiscum communicare potuisses?»

source: Naboredisley smiled back but remained silent.
target: Naboredisley iterum subridens, sed tacitus mansit.

source: Lumian shifted the topic.
target: Lumian rem mutavit.

source: “Did you have a hand in the deaths of those two adventurers who were investigating Flores?”
target: «Num particeps fuisti in mortibus illorum duorum exploratorum, qui Flores investigabantur?»

source: “Consider it a bit of interest,” Naboredisley replied, glancing around.
target: «Putate hoc quasi parum interesse,» respondit Naboredisley, circumspiciens.

source: He smiled and pulled a chair over, casually remarking, “You lack the necessary courtesy.”
target: Subridens, sella traxit et leve dixit, «Comitatem necessariam carent.»

source: “Because we never considered making a deal with you,” Franca deliberately stated.
target: «Quia numquam tecum pactum faciendo cogitavimus,» Franca firmiter declamavit.

source: “I won’t make a deal with a Demon.”
target: «Non faciam pactum cum daemon.»

source: Naboredisley chuckled and said, “Although it’s amusing for a Demoness to claim she won’t trade with a Demon, I can assure you that I won’t force you into a deal.
target: Naboredisley subridens dixit: «Quamvis iocum sit, cum Demonissa dicat se non commerciare cum daemon, certiorem te faciam me te in pacto non coacturum esse,

source: I won’t even hinder you from informing the Church of Earth Mother about Flores later.
target: neque quidem tibi impediam, ut postea Ecclesiam Matris Terrae de Flores certiorem facias.

source: I differ from my inept peers.
target: Ab inaptis condiscipulis meis differto.

source: I prefer transparent trade, avoiding the convoluted legalese of contracts where terms and conditions are twisted.
target: Commercium perspicuum praefero, vitans obscuram contractuum legem, ubi termini et condiciones convoluti sunt.

source: I’ll make you choose to trade with me, even knowing the content and price.
target: Te cogam eligere commercium mecum, etiam cum contentum et pretium tibi nota sint.

source: “I decline,” Franca replied with a smile.
target: «Declino,» Franca subridens respondit.

source: Naboredisley narrowed his eyes dangerously but maintained his usual amiable demeanor.
target: Naboredisley oculos periculositer angustiavit, sed mores suos amabiles consuetos retinuit.

source: “You can listen first before deciding if you want to accept this deal.
target: «Primum audire potes, antequam decernas an hoc pactum accipias.»

source: I won’t boast that I can fulfill any of your wishes, but I can help you fulfill most of them.
target: Non gloriabor quod quaslibet tuas optiones implere valeam, sed plurimas eorum effici te adiuvare possum.

source: This is a promise from an ancient Demon.
target: Hoc est promissum ab antiquo daemon.

source: “Ancient?” Lumian looked curious.
target: «Antiquus?» Lumian curiosus aspexit.

source: “Have you heard of the Ancient Sun God?”
target: «Audivistine de Deo Solis Antiqui?»

source: Naboredisley’s expression darkened subtly.
target: Vultus Naboredisley subtiliter obscuratus est.

source: “I’m aware.”
target: «Scio.»

source: “Can you tell me about Him? The deity I believe in now seems to be the resurrected Him.”
target: «Potesne mihi de eo narrare? Deitas in quam nunc credo videtur ille renatus esse.»

source: Lumian’s lips curled up, revealing two rows of pearly‑white teeth.
target: Labia Lumiani incurvata sunt, duo ordines dentium candidissimarum ostendentes.

source: “This can be used as compensation for the transaction, but it has to be paid first before we fulfill the contract.
target: «Hoc pro compensatione transactionis adhiberi potest, sed primum solvi debet, antequam contractum exsequamur,

source: Don’t think of fabricating it. That would be blasphemy to my Lord.”
target: noli fingere illud; id erit blasphemia erga Dominum meum.»

source: Naboredisley fell silent. After a few seconds, he smiled and said, “As I mentioned earlier, I can’t accomplish certain things and fulfill certain wishes. This is one of them.”
target: Naboredisley tacuit. Post aliquot secundas, subridens dixit: «Ut antea dixi, quaedam efficere nec quibusdam votis servire valeo. Haec una ex his est.»

source: When one’s humble enough, it’s really difficult to win a war of words…
target: Cum quis satis humilis sit, verum est difficile verborum proelium vincere.

source: Lumian sighed inwardly and turned to Franca, silently inquiring if she wanted to seize this opportunity to the‑table Transaction.
target: Lumian intus suspiravit et ad Francam convertebatur, tacite interrogeantem an hanc opportunitatem ad transactionem “sub mensa” capere velit.

source: Franca hesitated for a moment before addressing Naboredisley.
target: Franca paulisper cunctata est antequam ad Naboredisley loqueretur.

source: “Tell me about the deal first before I decide.”
target: «Primum narra mihi de pacto, antequam decernam.»

source: Naboredisley chuckled.
target: Naboredisley risit.

source: “A wise decision. I hope you can help me kill another Demon’s descendant. He resides somewhere in the Berserk Sea.
target: «Sapienter constrinxisti. Spero te me adiuvare posse ut alium daemonis progeniem occidam; ille alicubi in Mari Furioso habitat.»

source: “Don’t worry, Demon descendants are cold, cruel, and blood‑thirsty.
target: Noli timere, daemonis progenies frigidae, crudeles atque sanguine sitientes sunt.

source: He definitely meets the death penalty standard in your hearts.”
target: Indubitanter in vestris cordibus normas supplicii mortis convenit.

source: “Then why don’t you do it yourself?”
target: «Tum cur ipse non facis?»

source: Franca clicked her tongue.
target: Franca lingua striduit.

source: “You seem quite powerful.”
target: «Valde potens videris.»

source: Is it because you’re sealed?
target: An quia sigillatus es?

source: Or could it be that he can’t leave the Abyss and can only project himself onto a human like now, unable to maintain it for long?
target: An fortasse non potest Abyssum relinquere et solum se in homine, ut nunc, proicere, diutius manere non valeat?

source: Naboredisley replied calmly, “Any abnormal movements from me will attract the attention of the other Demon.
target: Naboredisley tranquillē respondit: «Quaecumque abnorma motus a me efferentur, alii daemonis attentionem allicient.

source: The reward for this transaction is that I fulfill one of your wishes.
target: Merces huius transactionis est, ut unum ex tuis votis impleam.

source: It’s a predetermined wish that I can fulfill.”
target: Praedefinitum est votum quod exsequi possum.

source: “Can you help us digest the potion in our bodies?” Lumian probed.
target: «Potesne nobis adiuvare ad potionem in corporibus nostris digerendam?» Lumian interrogavit.

source: Naboredisley shook his head.
target: Naboredisley caput concussit.

source: “I won’t lie to you. I can’t do it. The digestion of the potion is a personal matter.
target: «Non mentiar vobis. Non possum id facere. Digestio potionis res privata est.

source: “Of course, I can create conditions and opportunities to indirectly help you digest the potion as soon as possible, but whether you can seize those opportunities depends on yourselves.”
target: «Certe, condiciones et occasiones creare possum, ut vobis indirecte ad potionem quam primum digerendam auxilium feram; sed utrum illas occasiones capere valeatis, in vobis ipsis dependent.»

source: Quite honest… Franca muttered silently.
target: Valde honestum… Franca tacite murmurat.

source: Suddenly, she revealed a bright smile.
target: Subito, ipsa nitidum subrisum ostendit.

source: “This deal tempts me, but I need a reliable and powerful witness.”
target: «Hoc pactum me tentat, sed mihi testem fidum et validum opus est.»

source: Author’s Note: The inspiration for the love incantation in the previous chapter originated from the real world.
target: Nota Auctoris: Inspiratio incantationis amoris in capitulo previo ex mundo reali orta est.

source: I believe I’ve shared it on my public WeChat account before—Aphrodite’s hidden name is Nepherieri, meaning “beautiful eyes.”
target: Credo me id ante in meo publico WeChat ratione communicavisse—occultum nomen Aphroditis est Nepherieri, quod “oculi pulchri” significat.

source: Repeating this incantation can win a woman’s love.
target: Hoc incantationem repetere potest feminae amorem vincere.

source: When I read about this, I found it a little sinister.
target: Cum de hoc legerim, me paulum sinistrum arbitratus sum.

source: I mainly changed the pronunciation.
target: Praecipue pronuntiatiōnem mutavi.
